name: Empire Metal Products
old_description: HVAC sheet metal, curbs and adapters, and custom fabrication built by people who answer the phone, catch problems early, and stand behind the work.
about:
Empire Metal Products was founded in 2004 in Phoenix, Arizona. The company operates two campuses in the city — a North Campus focused on commercial HVAC and a South Campus handling residential HVAC, curbs, and custom fabrication — along with an East Valley pickup location at AAA A/C Supply in Mesa. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The shop produces HVAC sheet metal (duct, spiral, fittings, transitions), roof curbs and adapters, and custom welded fabrications including structural components, platforms, brackets, racks, and assemblies. Processes cover cutting, bending, punching, welding, lock-seam and spiral duct fabrication, coil-line production, and pre-fab assembly with taps and fittings installed. The combined facilities span 80,000 square feet with 150-plus employees, processing over four million pounds of metal annually and serving more than 600 contractors.

Primary customers are HVAC and mechanical contractors across Arizona, from commercial and residential projects to specialized needs such as restaurant stainless wall panels, mini-split displays, truck and trailer fabrication, and material-handling carts. The company also supports contractors with daily delivery routes throughout Phoenix and freight options for wider distribution.

Empire emphasizes a fabricator-first mindset: verifying dimensions and unusual conditions before production, labeling orders for easier staging, and maintaining clear communication so questions are resolved before parts hit the floor. The approach grew from early contractor requests for faster duct packages, cleaner curb changeouts, and heavier custom assemblies, building a reputation on work that fits when it reaches the field.
